strategy.headline: A strong car wash takes more than extra equipment and staff.
strategy.intro: Sparkle Auto is built around five operating strategies:
strategy.videoTitle: Five Strategies for a Stronger Car Wash

strategies.title: Every Car Follows a Clear Route
strategies.principle: Booking or walk-in → arrival → staff assignment → service → review → payment → handover.
strategies.insideSparkle: Every car has a status, service, assigned team member, and activity history.

strategies.title: Every Number Has a Source
strategies.principle: Every service, discount, expense, and payment method has to be clear.
strategies.insideSparkle: Revenue is tied to the car, service, and branch, with expected-versus-actual review and day closing.

strategies.title: Everyone Knows Their Role
strategies.principle: The owner sees the full picture, the manager runs operations, the cashier handles payments, and the worker sees the task.
strategies.insideSparkle: Roles and permissions + attendance + shifts + responsibilities.

strategies.title: The Customer Relationship Doesn’t End After the Wash
strategies.principle: Every visit helps you understand the customer, their car, and their behavior.
strategies.insideSparkle: Customer history + cars + visits + wallet + offers + loyalty.

strategies.title: Expand the System, Not the Chaos
strategies.principle: Expansion should not multiply calls and scattered reports.
strategies.insideSparkle: Monitor every branch in one place while keeping data, permissions, and reports properly separated.

faq.headline: Answers to the questions car-wash owners ask most.

items.question: Is Sparkle Auto only a booking system?
items.answer: No. It is a complete operations system covering cars, team, services, inventory, finance, customers, and branches.

items.question: Do I need more than one branch?
items.answer: No. It works for one branch, and its value grows with the size of your operation and the number of branches.

items.question: Will the team know how to use it?
items.answer: Each employee sees and learns only the part relevant to their role.

items.question: Does it replace the branch manager?
items.answer: No. It helps the manager organize operations and turn their experience into a clear way of working.

items.question: I already use WhatsApp and a notebook. Why change?
items.answer: Because you need one source for status, responsibility, history, and revenue.

items.question: Is it accounting software?
items.answer: It organizes the finances connected to car-wash operations, but it is not a complete replacement for an accountant or general accounting software.

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: It depends on your branches, services, data, and team. After the operations review, we define a realistic plan.

items.question: What happens during the 14-day trial?
items.answer: A clear goal + data setup + real operations + result reviews.

items.question: What if I need a feature that isn’t available?
items.answer: We review the problem first and determine whether the solution already exists, is on the roadmap, or requires custom work.

items.question: Can I monitor the car wash while I’m away?
items.answer: Yes. You can monitor statuses, information, and reports according to your permissions—without constant phone calls.

items.question: How do I know whether it is right for my car wash?
items.answer: Book an Operations Review. If it isn’t right for your current stage, we’ll tell you honestly.
